name: roxy-browser-clone
description: RoxyBrowser 功能克隆 - 指纹浏览器桌面端（跨境电商多账号防关联）
author: roxy-clone

scripts.db:check: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc scripts/db-schema-log.ts src/main/entities.ts --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --experimentalDecorators --emitDecoratorMetadata --outDir .tmp_dbsl && node .tmp_dbsl/scripts/db-schema-log.js
scripts.db:sync: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc scripts/sync-schema.ts scripts/seed-default.ts src/main/entities.ts src/main/secretKey.ts src/shared/secretCrypto.ts --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --experimentalDecorators --emitDecoratorMetadata --outDir .tmp_dbsync && node .tmp_dbsync/scripts/sync-schema.js && node .tmp_dbsync/scripts/seed-default.js
scripts.migrate:secrets: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc scripts/migrate-secrets.ts src/shared/secretCrypto.ts src/main/secretKey.ts --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --outDir .tmp_mg && node .tmp_mg/scripts/migrate-secrets.js
scripts.seed:test-logs: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc scripts/seed-test-logs.ts src/main/entities.ts --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --experimentalDecorators --emitDecoratorMetadata --outDir .tmp_sl && node .tmp_sl/scripts/seed-test-logs.js
